ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible ventral surface, with low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated on the trailing edge and lateral tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity (white) region central to both lobes. High-contrast low-intensity (black) band along the entire trailing edge, widening significantly at the lateral tips. Sparse low-intensity focal spots distributed in the lower-central region near the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 115 degrees; central convergence is sharp with immediate divergence into the trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations range from shallow scallops to deep notches, most pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a broad, slightly concave arc from the notch to the tips; lower boundary exhibits a smooth convex sweep from the peduncle to the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark pixel clusters visible on the far right lateral tip and several discrete dark focal points near the center-left ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible on the high-intensity background of the left lobe, extending diagonally from the mid-section toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular serration and localized indentation along the trailing edge boundary suggesting historical physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct dark vertical marker or protrusion visible at the base of the fluke near the peduncle midline against the white background.
